'''2015 European Championship Day 2 Lukasz Saczek LS Combat Preparedness''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Lukasz Saczek]] at [[2015 European Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Lukasz Saczek]]
* '''Event:''' [[2015 European Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates|Ref3-L-wellhandlethis.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Combat Preparedness Saczek LS 2015.txt |Download]]
* '''Username:''' Fon-Q
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2015-european-championships/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013125919/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2015-european-championships.html Internet Archive]
